This part works exactly as I'd want: I changed the title to "Roman Pasta Recipes to Try" and the description to my own wording, saved, and the link itself, the site name, and the preview image all stayed put. Correcting the words the app gathered while leaving the actual link and its identity alone is right — that's what I was asking for way back when we first talked about the auto-gathered details.

But I want to push back a little on one assumption. You said only the title and description need manual correction. That's *usually* true — but not always. Sometimes I'll save a link and later realize the address itself is slightly off — maybe I grabbed a tracking-cluttered version, or the page moved and I want to point it at the right one. In those cases I'd want to be able to fix the address too, not have to delete the whole thing and start over and lose my tags and notes. So I'd like the address itself to be editable as well, alongside the title and description.

The title-and-description editing you showed is right — I'd just want the link to be fixable too. Can we add that?
